Publications Award Service CV GitHub

Hello! I am Yuheng Zhao (赵宇恒). I am an ELLIS Postdoctoral Fellow in the Computational Behavior Lab at Aalto University, working with Prof. Antti Oulasvirta. I received my Ph.D. in Statistics from the School of Data Science at Fudan University, supervised by Prof. Siming Chen in FDUVIS Lab. I also completed a research internship advised by Dr. Yu Zhang.

My research focuses on LLM-driven intelligent visual analytics, human-AI interaction and AI4Science. I combine methods from visualization, artificial intelligence, and human-computer interaction to build intelligent interfaces that help people understand complex data and coordinate with AI agents.
